config.a2a.no_auth_warning: No authentication enabled. A2A endpoints are publicly accessible. Enable at least one auth method for production.
config.a2a.no_skills: No skills configured (default will be used)
config.a2a.skills_desc: Advertised skills in the Agent Card. If empty, a default skill is created.
help.a2a.agent_name: Public agent name shown in the Agent Card.
help.a2a.agent_url: Override the auto-detected agent URL. Use when behind a reverse proxy or on a custom domain.
help.a2a.base_path: URL path prefix for A2A endpoints (default: /a2a).
help.a2a.client_enabled: Enable the A2A client to connect to and communicate with remote A2A agents.
help.a2a.llm_provider: Select which LLM provider to use for A2A tasks. Leave empty to use the main LLM.
help.a2a.port: Set to 0 to share the main web server port. Set a number to run A2A on a dedicated port.
help.a2a.server_enabled: Expose this AuraGo instance as an A2A-compatible agent that other agents can communicate with via the A2A protocol.
config.a2a.confirm_remove_skill_message: Skill "{name}" is removed from the list and is no longer offered to other agents once you save.
config.a2a.confirm_remove_agent_message: Remote agent "{name}" with its card URL and credentials is removed from the list and deleted when you save. AuraGo can no longer delegate tasks to it.
config.a2a.help_rest_binding: Offers the A2A interface as a REST API over HTTP. This is the most common binding.
config.a2a.help_jsonrpc: Additionally offers the A2A interface as JSON-RPC, for clients that expect this protocol.
config.a2a.help_grpc: Additionally offers the A2A interface over gRPC. Uses the separate port set below.
config.a2a.help_grpc_port: TCP port of the gRPC server (default 50051). It must not collide with other services.
config.a2a.help_streaming: Lets clients receive responses continuously via Server-Sent Events instead of only at the end.
config.a2a.help_push: Lets the server notify clients by webhook when tasks change.
config.a2a.help_api_key_enabled: Clients must send a valid API key. Recommended as soon as the server is reachable from outside.
config.a2a.help_bearer_enabled: Clients must send a valid bearer token. Recommended as soon as the server is reachable from outside.
config.a2a.help_agent_description: Short description in the Agent Card: tells other agents what this agent can do.
config.a2a.help_agent_version: Version shown in the Agent Card, such as 1.0.0. It is for display only.
config.a2a.help_api_key: Secret key that clients send in the header. It is stored encrypted in the vault.
config.a2a.help_bearer_secret: Secret token that clients send as a bearer token. It is stored encrypted in the vault.
config.a2a.skills_fields_help: Per row: a short ID without spaces, a name and a description of what the skill does. Other agents see them in the Agent Card.
config.a2a.remote_agents_help: Per agent: ID, display name, Agent Card address, and an API key or bearer token if the agent requires sign-in.
